# 4 Ezra Chapter 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 6th Ezra (Christian addition) — Conclusion

---

**1** Woe to you, Babylon and Asia! Woe to you, Egypt and Syria!

**2** Put on sackcloth and goat's hair. Weep for your children. Mourn. Your destruction is here.

**3** A sword has been sent against you. Who is going to turn it back?

**4** A fire has been sent against you. Who is going to put it out?

**5** Calamities have been sent against you. Who is going to drive them away?

**6** Can someone drive a hungry lion out of the forest? Can someone put out a fire in dry straw once it has caught?

**7** Can someone call back an arrow already shot by a powerful archer?

**8** The LORD God sends calamities. Who is going to stop them?

**9** Fire goes out from his wrath. Who is going to extinguish it?

**10** He hurls lightning — who won't be afraid? He thunders — who won't tremble?

**11** The LORD speaks his threat, and who won't be shattered to pieces in his presence?

**12** The earth shakes, and its foundations with it. The sea heaves from the deep, waves churning, even the fish in it — all before the LORD and the blazing glory of his power.

**13** For his right hand that draws the bow is strong, and the arrows he shoots are sharp — they will not miss when he begins to shoot them to the ends of the earth.

**14** Behold — the calamities are released. They will not turn back until they have come on the earth.

**15** The fire is lit. It will not be put out until it has consumed the earth's foundations.

**16** Just as an arrow shot by a powerful archer does not come back, so the calamities sent on the earth will not turn back.

**17** Oh no — oh no! Who will rescue me in those days?

**18** Here is what begins: sorrows and great mourning; famine and widespread death; wars, and the powers struck with terror; the beginning of all evils! What do I do when this all arrives?

**19** Look — famine and plague, suffering and anguish: sent as corrective punishments.

**20** And even so, people will refuse to turn from their wickedness. They will not keep the punishments in mind.

**21** Look — food will become so cheap on earth that people will think things are fine, and even at that moment the calamities will be multiplying on the earth — sword, famine, and total chaos.

**22** Because many who live on earth will die of famine, and those who survive the famine will be killed by the sword.

**23** The dead will be thrown out like garbage, and no one will be left to mourn them. The earth will be deserted and its cities torn down.

**24** No one will be left to farm the earth and plant it.

**25** The trees will bear fruit — and who will pick it?

**26** The grapes will ripen — and who will tread them? For everywhere will be empty of people.

**27** People will long just to see another human face or hear another human voice.

**28** Of an entire city, ten will survive; of an entire countryside, two — hidden in thick forests and rocky caves.

**29** Like an olive grove where three or four olives are left on each tree,

**30** or a vineyard after the harvest where a few clusters remain missed by the searchers:

**31** so in those days three or four survivors will be left after those who search the houses with swords.

**32** The earth will lie waste. The fields will dry up. Every road and path will be overgrown with thorns because no one passes through.

**33** Young women will mourn with no husbands to marry. Women will mourn for their dead husbands. Daughters will mourn with no one to provide for them.

**34** Their husbands-to-be will be cut down in battle. Their husbands will die of starvation.

**35** Now listen, you servants of the LORD. Hear and understand this.

**36** This is the word of the LORD — receive it. Do not trust the gods the LORD spoke of.

**37** The calamities are drawing close and will not be delayed.

**38** Think of a woman in her ninth month of pregnancy — in the two or three hours of hardest labor there is intense pain in her womb — and when the child arrives there is not a moment's delay:

**39** the calamities will fall on the earth in exactly the same way, without delay, and the world will mourn and anguish will grip it from every side.

**40** My people, hear my word: prepare for battle, and live through those coming evils as if you were only passing through on a journey.

**41** If you sell, sell as if you were already in flight. If you buy, buy knowing you will lose everything.

**42** If you trade, trade knowing you will see no profit. If you build, build knowing you will never live there.

**43** If you plant, plant as if you will not harvest. If you tend your vines, tend them knowing you will not pick the grapes.

**44** If you marry, marry knowing you may have no children. If you don't marry, live as the widowed.

**45** Because in every case, labor leads to nothing.

**46** Foreigners will harvest what you planted, seize what you own, tear down your homes, and take your children away as captives — because it is in exile and famine that your children will be born.

**47** Those who trade are little better than thieves. The more they decorate their cities, homes, possessions, and bodies —

**48** the angrier I become with them for their sins, says the LORD.

**49** The way a prostitute envies a genuinely beautiful and honorable woman,

**50** righteousness will despise iniquity when the wicked woman dresses herself up — and will accuse her to her face when he comes who searches out every sin on earth.

**51** Therefore do not be like her; do not follow her example.

**52** For just a little while longer, and iniquity will be removed from the earth and righteousness will reign over you.

**53** Let no sinner claim they have not sinned. God will pour burning coals on the head of anyone who says before the LORD God and his glory: I have not sinned.

**54** Behold — the LORD knows every deed of every person: their imaginations, their thoughts, their hearts.

**55** He spoke at the beginning: Let the earth be made — and it was. Let the heaven be made — and it was.

**56** His word fixed the stars in place. He knows their number.

**57** Who can probe the deep and all that is in it? Who has measured the sea and its full content?

**58** Who has sealed the sea within the waters and suspended it by his word?

**59** Who spread out the sky like a dome and set it on the waters?

**60** Who made springs in the desert and mountain pools at the summits, so that rivers flow down from the heights to water the earth?

**61** Who formed the human being, placed a heart in the center of the body, and breathed into them breath, life, and understanding?

**62** And who made fire and sent it down from heaven, to come upon everything he made at his command?

**63** Who formed the earth? — the one who governs it.

**64** Who holds the sea? — the one who calms it.

**65** Who holds the whole earth from beginning to end? — the one who holds all things in his hands.

**66** This is what the LORD says: Do you not recognize that it is God who made all of these things?

**67** That is exactly why the LORD sees everything any person does and knows everything a person plans to do.

**68** He will bring it all to judgment — every deed, every thought.

**69** He will search Jerusalem and every city of Israel, the way a person searches a house with a lamp.

**70** He will expose every secret and make it visible before everyone.

**71** Woe to those sinners who try to hide their sins! The LORD will rigorously examine all their deeds and expose them publicly.

**72** But those who fear the LORD will not be afraid or tremble before him; because they know that even though they have sinned, they have also done what is right.

**73** Hear this, you nations, and understand whom we serve.

**74** Do not serve him alongside other gods. Serve the LORD alone — so that you may escape the kind of tribulation that has just been described.

**75** And beyond all this, take heed, all of you who bear the LORD's name.

**76** You who remain — hold firm in your faith. You know that your reward goes beyond all measuring.

**77** Rejoice in the prosperity of the righteous, even when you yourselves are not righteous.

**78** For this is the end that the LORD has planned for you.
